q: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I fear no evil; for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
Do not lord it over those in your charge, but be examples to the flock. And when the chief shepherd appears, you will win the crown of glory that never fades away.
points.apply: Parents, teachers, leaders: serve those in your care by example this week.

concl: The Church stands on Peter's confession of faith, made firm by Christ's prayer.
With Peter's successor we confess: you are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.
2027-02-22.resolve: Pray each day of this week for the Pope, your bishop and your parish priest.

intro: Theme: “The greatest among you will be your servant.”
Washed from scarlet sins, freed from a religion of display, faithful like Polycarp.

q: Wash yourselves; make yourselves clean; remove the evil of your doings from before my eyes; cease to do evil, learn to do good; seek justice, rescue the oppressed, defend the orphan, plead for the widow.
Religion that is pure and undefiled before God, the Father, is this: to care for orphans and widows in their distress, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.
points.apply: Visit or help one widow, orphan or lonely person before Sunday.

points.h: Though your sins are like scarlet
q: Come now, let us argue it out, says the LORD: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be like snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
If we confess our sins, he who is faithful and just will forgive us our sins and cleanse us from all unrighteousness.
points.apply: Plan your Lenten confession: choose the day and the church now.

sub: One Teacher, all brothers and sisters.
q: He has told you, O mortal, what is good; and what does the LORD require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
The greatest among you will be your servant. All who exalt themselves will be humbled, and all who humble themselves will be exalted.
points.apply: Like Polycarp, let your life speak louder than your words: one hidden service each day this week.

concl: God washes us and asks us to do good.
Jesus makes greatness into service, and the saints show it to the end.
2027-02-23.resolve: Do one hidden act of service each day this week.

intro: Theme: “Not to be served but to serve.”
The persecuted prophet, the cup of the Lord and the greatness of service.

sub: A prophet who prayed for his enemies.
q: Is evil a recompense for good? Yet they have dug a pit for my life. Remember how I stood before you to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them.
Then Jesus said, “Father, forgive them; for they do not know what they are doing.”
points.apply: Pray by name for someone who has repaid your good with evil.

q: Into your hand I commit my spirit; you have redeemed me, O LORD, faithful God.
But Jesus answered, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink?” They said to him, “We are able.”
points.apply: Accept one difficulty today as a sip from the Lord's cup, and offer it with trust.

points.h: Not to be served but to serve
q: But he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities; upon him was the punishment that made us whole, and by his bruises we are healed.
just as the Son of Man came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life a ransom for many.”
points.apply: Choose one person this week whom you will serve without expecting anything back.

concl: The innocent prophet points to the innocent Son.
The way to greatness in the kingdom is the towel and the cup.
2027-02-24.resolve: Take the lowest place in one situation each day this week.

intro: Theme: “At his gate lay a poor man named Lazarus.”
Two trees, two men, one gate, and the word that calls us while there is time.

q: Blessed are those who trust in the LORD, whose trust is the LORD. They shall be like a tree planted by water, sending out its roots by the stream.
Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust consume and where thieves break in and steal;
points.apply: Name one false security you lean on, and give it to God in prayer.

q: Those who oppress the poor insult their Maker, but those who are kind to the needy honor him.
How does God's love abide in anyone who has the world's goods and sees a brother or sister in need and yet refuses help?
points.apply: Give this week's Lenten savings directly to someone in need near you.

q: I the LORD test the mind and search the heart, to give to all according to their ways, according to the fruit of their doings.
He said to him, ‘If they do not listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be convinced even if someone rises from the dead.’ ”
points.apply: Read one chapter of the Gospel each day this week, and act on one line of it.

points.apply: Bring your envy to confession this Lent, and pray daily for the one you envy.

intro: Theme: “While he was still far off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion.”
The God who delights in mercy, the son who came home, and the son who must still come in.

points.h: Who is a God like you?

points.apply: Throw one old sin you keep fishing out back into the sea: believe it is forgiven, and stop accusing yourself.

points.apply: Welcome back one person who has returned to the Church or to your family, and rejoice with them.

concl: God delights to forgive, and runs to meet us.
